Learn more Memory $ 0.00001929 per GB / sec about $ 50 per GB-month, while running CPU $ 0.00001929 per vCPU / sec about $ 50 per vCPU-month, active use only Egress $ 0.05 per GB for sandboxes Commonly Asked Questions Which plan is right for me? Free is for trying Railway and running a small app at no cost. Hobby is for indie hackers and developers to build and deploy personal projects. Pro is for professional developers and their teams shipping to production. Enterprise is for dev teams building and deploying production applications with large replica size, SLA, and/or compliance needs. What does the Free plan include? The Free plan costs $0 per month and includes $1 of usage credits every month, with no credit card required. Services sleep after a few minutes without outbound traffic and wake on the next request. You get 1 project with up to 3 services, up to 1 vCPU and 0.5 GB of RAM per service, 0.5 GB of volume storage, and one-click Postgres, Redis, MySQL and MongoDB. The Free plan does not expire. Do services on the Free plan sleep or spin down? Yes. Free plan services are serverless: after 5 to 10 minutes without outbound traffic they sleep, and the next request wakes them. Sleep is based on outbound traffic, so a bot holding a WebSocket or a worker polling a queue keeps itself awake. Hobby and above run always-on. How does the trial work? Every new account starts with a 30-day trial that includes a one-time grant of $5 in credits, with no credit card required. The credits apply to any usage on the platform. When the trial ends or the credits run out, running deployments are stopped. You can then downgrade to the Free plan from the Plans page and redeploy within its limits, or upgrade to Hobby or Pro. If you upgrade while you still have trial credits, the remaining balance carries over to your new plan. How does the Hobby plan included usage work? Your Hobby plan subscription includes $5 of usage per month. If your total usage at the end of your billing period is $5 or less, you will not be charged extra for usage. If your total usage exceeds $5 in any given billing period, you will be charged total usage. Does included usage on Hobby accumulate? Included usage is reset at the end of every billing cycle and does not accumulate over time. How are sandboxes billed? Sandboxes run on Railway's VM primitive and bill on VM rates: $50 per GB of memory per month and $50 per vCPU per month, metered per second, plus $0.05 per GB of egress. You pay for the CPU a sandbox actually uses and the memory it holds while running, not for wall-clock uptime, so a sandbox waiting on a model or a user costs almost nothing. Destroyed sandboxes cost nothing, and an idle timeout destroys forgotten ones automatically. Sandbox usage draws from the same included credit as the rest of your plan. How can I get a receipt? When you make a payment, you will receive an email with your invoice and receipt attached. You can also find your billing history in Account > Billing. How to add company details on my invoice? Head to Account > Billing and click 'Manage Subscription'. From there, you can update your billing information, including billing address and Tax ID. What payment methods are accepted? Railway accepts credit cards for plan subscriptions and usage. We support invoice payments for customers on the Enterprise plan. Can I try Railway without a credit card? Yes. Neither the trial nor the Free plan requires a credit card. You only need to add a card to upgrade to Hobby or Pro. Can I upgrade or downgrade at any time? You can upgrade any time, and when you do, you will get to the features of your new plan, as well as access to more powerful resources, immediately. When you downgrade, the changes will take effect at the beginning of your next billing cycle. What happens when I cancel my subscription? When you cancel your subscription, if you're on Hobby or Pro, your plan will remain active through the end of your current billing period, and any usage will be charged at the end of the period. If you are on the Hobby plan and using prepaid credits as your payment method, your subscription will be canceled immediately and any credit balance you may have will be forfeited. For more information, check out the docs. . Mehr erfahren Anthropic Founder House, Founder Days, Builder Days und Hackathons, die von unserem Team veranstaltet werden. Veranstaltungen finden Online Livestreams, AMAs und On-Demand-Sitzungen, die in Ihren Zeitplan passen. Veranstaltungen finden Häufig gestellte Fragen Was ist das Claude Startups-Programm und kann ich mich bewerben? Claude Startups ist das Programm von Anthropic für Gründer in der Frühphase, die auf Claude bauen. Mitglieder erhalten Zugang zu Angeboten, Tools und Veranstaltungen, die ihnen helfen, ihr Unternehmen mit Claude zu führen. Das Interesse am Programm war weitaus höher, als wir erwartet hatten. Derzeit sind alle Plätze ausgebucht und wir nehmen keine neuen Bewerbungen an. Abonnieren Sie den Newsletter zu Claude Startup , um zu erfahren, wann die nächste Bewerbungsphase beginnt, und um die neuesten Updates für Startups zu erhalten, die auf Claude bauen. Habe ich als Mitglied weiterhin Zugang zum Programm? Ja, das Programm wird für aktuelle Mitglieder fortgesetzt. Ihre Mitgliedschaft beinhaltet Angebote für KI-native Tools über den Claude Startup Stack, Zugang zu zweiwöchentlichen Gruppensitzungen mit dem Applied AI-Team von Anthropic sowie Einladungen zu Veranstaltungen, Hackathons und Community-Meetups im Rahmen von Claude Startup. Ich habe mich beworben und wurde abgelehnt. Was passiert mit meiner Bewerbung? Derzeit sind alle Plätze ausgebucht, sodass wir die Bewerbungen, die sich noch in Prüfung befanden, nicht weiter berücksichtigen konnten. Alle Betroffenen wurden per E-Mail benachrichtigt. Auch wenn wir derzeit keinen Platz für weitere Mitglieder hatten, ermutigen wir Sie, sich zu bewerben, sobald die nächste Bewerbungsphase beginnt. Was ist der Claude Startup Stack? Angebote von KI-nativen Unternehmen, die mit Claude arbeiten, aus den Bereichen Vertrieb, Design, Daten, Meetings und Engineering. Mitglieder können jedes Angebot mit einem Code in der Claude Console einlösen. Was genau sind Applied AI-Sitzungen? Applied AI-Sitzungen sind Live-Gruppensitzungen für Mitglieder, die alle zwei Wochen als Webinar stattfinden. Jede deckt ein Thema ab und beinhaltet ein AMA mit dem Applied AI-Team von Anthropic. On ElevenCreative , Free is $0 with 10,000 credits. Enterprise pricing is custom. How much do Image & Video generations cost on ElevenLabs? Image & Video is included from Starter upward and uses shared credits. Free includes images only, up to 3 per day. Cost varies by model, resolution, and length and is shown before you generate. API use needs Pro or above. When do my ElevenLabs credits reset, do they roll over, and can I top up? Credits reset each billing cycle, starting the day you subscribed. On paid plans, unused credits roll over for up to two months, up to 2x your quota (balance capped at 3x). Rollover ends if you downgrade or cancel and does not apply to Free. Pay-as-you-go top-ups are separate and expire 12 months after purchase. Your balance is on the subscription page. Do you offer annual billing and what does it cost? ElevenLabs offers annual billing with two months free. Annual prices are $60 (Starter), $220 (Creator), $990 (Pro), $2,990 (Scale), and $9,900 (Business), which is $5, $18.33, $82.50, $249.17, and $825 per month. Until December 1, 2026, Black Friday lowers the first-year price of Creator and Pro. Am I charged for every generation and can I regenerate for free? Credits are charged per generation and not per download. On the website, you’re able to get 2 free regenerations within 2 hours if the text, voice, and model stay the same. This does not apply to ElevenAPI or Enterprise workspaces. What happens if I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel my subscription? Moving to a higher plan restarts your billing cycle straight away, and any credits you haven't used carry over into the new allowance. Moving down or cancelling keeps your current plan running until the cycle ends. After that your workspace drops to Free and leftover paid credits are lost. You can cancel whenever you like. What payment methods and currencies does ElevenLabs accept? Pay by credit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. UPI is also available in India, where charges are in INR, while all other customers pay in USD. Choose monthly or yearly billing. Prepaid cards cannot be used directly. Prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties, which are added at checkout. level Email Priority (Slack Connect) Dedicated Start for free Join the pros Contact sales FAQ Questions about plans and credits Is LlamaParse Open Source? No. LlamaParse is our commercial platform for parsing and extracting documents, and every account gets 10,000 free credits a month. If you need open source, LiteParse is our fast local parser for simpler documents, with no API key needed. The open-source LlamaIndex framework and Workflows are separate projects for building AI apps, and you don’t need them to use LlamaParse. How many credits does it cost to parse or extract one page? It depends on the tier you choose: Parse tier Credits per page Per 1,000 pages, Pay-as-you-go Per 1,000 pages, Pro Fast 1 $1.50 $1.25 Cost-effective 3 $4.50 $3.75 Agentic 10 $15.00 $12.50 Agentic Plus 25 $37.50 $31.25 Layout extraction adds 3 credits per page on any tier. Extract adds its own credits per page on top of the parse tier. Re-parsing a cached file costs nothing. See credit pricing for every option. Does LlamaParse deploy on premises? Yes. You can run LlamaParse four ways: managed SaaS in the US or the EU, single-tenant SaaS managed by us, in your own cloud on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, or on-premises in your own environment. The last three are Enterprise options. In your own cloud or on-premises, your documents and data stay in your environment, and you choose where model inference runs. On managed SaaS, data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and cached results are deleted after 48 hours; you can turn caching off. LlamaParse is also available on the AWS and Microsoft Azure marketplaces. See deployment options . What compliance certifications does LlamaParse have? LlamaParse has a SOC 2 Type II report, available in our Trust Center . For GDPR, we offer an EU region and a Data Processing Agreement. For HIPAA, Enterprise customers get HIPAA-compliant processing, with a Business Associate Agreement on request. Is LlamaParse the same as LlamaCloud? Yes. LlamaParse is the new name for the platform previously called LlamaCloud. You’ll still see LlamaCloud in some SDK package names and older docs; they refer to the same platform. What happens when I run out of credits? Your monthly credits are used first, then any credits you’ve bought. When the balance reaches zero, new jobs pause and jobs already running finish. To keep going, buy a credit pack or turn on auto-reload. Monthly credits reset each month and unused ones don’t carry over. How database billing works Document indexes (the Documents API) and vector indexes are billed the same way, on four meters: storage, reads, writes, and egress. Rates and plan limits are in the plan comparison table below. Storage Measured in GB across all your records. In a document index, record size counts every field in the schema, including vectors and text, plus metadata and the record ID. Reads A query or a full-text search uses 1 read unit per GB of the namespace it searches, with a minimum of 0.25. The number of results returned does not change the cost. A hybrid search sent as one request counts once. Two searches merged in your code count twice. On Dedicated Read Nodes, reads are a fixed hourly rate instead. Writes An upsert uses 1 write unit per KB of the request, with a minimum of 5 per request. An upsert or update that replaces an existing record also counts that record's size. Batching records into fewer requests avoids paying the minimum on each one. Egress Measured in GB of data returned to you by reads such as query, fetch, list, and search. Every plan includes a monthly allowance. Writes, index stats, and index management are not counted. Updated November 2026 . Formulas and worked examples are in Understand Pinecone cost .
